title: Routing decision auditor: lightweight per-request provenance sink & hop-health markers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a lightweight, append-only per-request provenance sink and a set of hop-health markers that make region selection, tier routing, and fallback variant decisions explorable with low-cost storage. This ticket scopes the runtime instrumentation, a compact envelope format, and the first dashboard + query patterns for SREs and runtime engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits a compact provenance envelope for each routed request with <= 500 bytes median overhead
Per-hop markers include decision_reason, model_variant, region, tier, latency_ms, and cache_hit boolean
A first-look Grafana dashboard and two ad-hoc queries (sla-impact, fallback-rate-by-region) are available
End-to-end traceability from API request ID -> routing envelope -> serving logs demonstrated with a sample traffic replay
Overhead on p95 request path latency <= 3% in staging with sampling at 10%
technical_notes: Use binary compacting (CBOR-lite) for provenance envelope to reduce wire size; fallback to JSON for debug build
Envelope will include a version field (prov_v1) to allow additive fields; avoid nested objects: flat key list preferred
Hop-health marker format: comma-delimited key=value tokens to keep per-hop payload under 128 bytes in typical cases
Runtime hook points: before routing decision return, after selection of model_variant, and on fallback execution path
Sampling: adaptive sampler that escalates capture to 100% for requests that trigger a fallback chain or exceed latency SLO
Storage: short-term hot store in Kafka topic 'routing-provenance' with compacted retention + daily rollups into storage bucket for long-term analysis
Privacy: strip customer PII from provenance envelopes; include a deterministic request hash for grouping and replayability
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with runtime and observability teams. Agreed to pursue compact envelope + hop markers instead of full trace duplication.
2026-03-04: Spike implemented in runtime: prov_v1 envelope emitted on 10% sampled traffic. Local microbench shows ~320B median overhead.
2026-03-06: Design review with Security. Decided to redact user_payload and include request_hash instead. Security asked for a short retention default (7 days) for hot topic streams.
2026-03-09: Draft PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4219. Initial schema and producer added. CI failing on linter rules for telemetry tags.
2026-03-11: Observability prototype dashboard created (Grafana) and shared: grafana.redwood.internal/d/route-auditor/prov-overview. Added ad-hoc query examples for fallback-rate-by-region.
2026-03-13: Performance test in staging with 10% sampling and adaptive escalation. p95 latency regression measured at 1.8% — within target. Preparing integration test for replay bundle validation.
